scope: Authored source and reusable method resources in the primary offline-deliveries tree. Byte-preserving archive; no model calls or execution authorization.

selection_rules.resources: Content contracts, protocols, reviewed general method README and prompt templates with unfilled placeholders. Runtime-derived schemas and question/review/request/model-response artifacts are excluded.
selection_rules.semantic_review: AST question/gold/quote/turn dict detection, long/structured literal and writer-name candidate review; synthetic unit-test fixtures are source, actual dataset materializers and mixed real-data literal scripts are excluded.

excluded_candidate_files.evidence: Local ordering_sources/SOURCE_MANIFEST.json identifies exact bytes as upstream source; no accompanying upstream license found in local reference snapshot.

checks.third_party_origin_review: All included hashes compared with URL/SHA256 entries in offline-deliveries local *MANIFEST*.json; one exact external reference match excluded. Source headers scanned for attribution/licensing markers; no further external copied source identified. This is not proof of original authorship for every file.

limitations: Not a data/results/models/environment backup; many historical jobs need omitted immutable inputs, budget ledgers and original workspace absolute paths.
Historical source does not mean the implementation is the current training route. No experiments were run to archive it.
Canonical schema generation/validation logic is preserved in Python; files named SCHEMA in per-request evidence are runtime artifacts, not authored canonical JSON schema.
Pruned frozen execution copies/backups/independent sources are not promoted over primary authored sources.
